metadata.dataset_title: Bangladeshi Dishes Knowledge Base — Ingredient Nutrient Profiles
metadata.nutrient_basis: Per 100 g raw ingredient; values are populated only where a matching entry was verified in the allowed sources.

allowed_sources.publisher: FAO / Institute of Nutrition and Food Science, University of Dhaka

allowed_sources.title: Nutrient Composition and Retention of Selected Traditional Bangladeshi Curries and Festival Dishes
allowed_sources.publisher: Bioresearch Communications; Institute of Nutrition and Food Science, University of Dhaka

metadata.source_policy: Only FCTB (FAO/INFS, 2013) and the specified INFS University of Dhaka study on BanglaJOL were used for nutrient values in this version. USDA FoodData Central was not used in this pass; no blogs or recipe sites were used for nutrient values.
metadata.null_policy: Null means the value was not verified in a directly matching approved source during this pass. It is not zero. Values recorded as trace in a source are null instead of falsely numeric.
metadata.carbohydrate_definition: carbs_g maps to FCTB 'Carbohydrate available'; it is not silently relabelled as total carbohydrate.
metadata.traceability: Every non-null nutrient value has a matching nutrient_sources entry containing source ID, table, PDF page index and FCTB food code.
